components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest Ink action for the one main step on a view, such as New funnel or Approve.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New funnel</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #0B2418); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--primary, #0B2418); color: var(--primary-ink, #FAF7EF); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0B2418); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Pill with a control hairline for second actions, such as Try the demo or Compare previews.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v4M12 17v4M3 12h4M17 12h4M6 6l2.5 2.5M15.5 15.5L18 18M6 18l2.5-2.5M15.5 8.5L18 6"/></svg>Try the demo</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control, rgba(11, 36, 24, .22)); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #0B2418); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--raised, #EDEADF); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0B2418); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled 40px field with a control hairline that turns ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); display: block; max-width: 360px; color: var(--text, #0B2418); } .ds-field span { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint, #61685C); margin-top: 5px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control, rgba(11, 36, 24, .22)); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface, #FAF7EF); color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: 14.5px; outline: 0; caret-color: var(--text, #0B2418); transition: border-color 160ms; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #61685C); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--text, #0B2418); }

components.css: .ds-side { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); width: 268px; padding: 8px; background: var(--side, #F2EFE4); border-right: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11, 36, 24, .12)); font-size: 14.5px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-new { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(11, 36, 24, .10)); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #0B2418); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-new svg { color: var(--sage, #4E6A50); } .ds-new:hover { background: var(--raised, #EDEADF); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--muted, #4F5A4D); text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms, color 160ms; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--raised, #EDEADF); color: var(--text, #0B2418); } .ds-row.on { background: var(--active, #E5E9DD); color: var(--text, #0B2418); font-weight: 500; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0B2418); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-label { margin: 0; padding: 14px 10px 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--faint, #61685C); }

components.name: Chips and Status Pills
components.description: 28px outline chips for topics, 22px tinted pills for status, pill tabs with an ink active state.
components.html: Market researchApprovedWaiting
components.css: .ds-chips { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11, 36, 24, .12)); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #4F5A4D); } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--pill-neutral-bg, #F2EFE4); color: var(--pill-neutral-ink, #4F5A4D); } .ds-pill.ok { background: var(--pill-positive-bg, #E5E9DD); color: var(--pill-positive-ink, #2F4A32); } .ds-tab { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #4F5A4D); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--raised, #EDEADF); color: var(--text, #0B2418); } .ds-tab.on { background: var(--text, #0B2418); color: var(--ground, #FAF7EF); font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0B2418); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Builder Card
components.description: 10px card for funnel types, templates and assets; selection adds an ink ring.
components.css: .ds-cards { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 220px)); gap: 12px; } .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 14px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(11, 36, 24, .12)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #FAF7EF); color: var(--text, #0B2418); font: inherit; font-size: 14.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms, background 160ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--control, rgba(11, 36, 24, .22)); background: var(--raised, #EDEADF); } .ds-card.on { border-color: var(--text, #0B2418); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--text, #0B2418); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0B2418); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card b { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--muted, #4F5A4D); } .ds-card small { font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint, #61685C); }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Calm error or info notice: ink on Side Paper in a full hairline, with the next step and a link.
components.html: The AI key was not accepted. Open Settings, then AI keys and paste a fresh key.
components.css: .ds-notice { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); max-width: 560px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control, rgba(11, 36, 24, .22)); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--side, #F2EFE4); color: var(--text, #0B2418); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-notice a { color: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-notice a:hover { color: var(--sage, #4E6A50); }

components.name: Chat Composer
components.description: 22px composer with a soft lift, an ink border on focus and a circular send button.
components.css: .ds-composer { font-family: var(--font, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; max-width: 640px; padding: 10px 10px 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--control, rgba(11, 36, 24, .22)); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--surface, #FAF7EF); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(11,36,24,.04), 0 8px 24px -16px rgba(11,36,24,.25); transition: border-color 160ms; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--text, #0B2418); } .ds-composer textarea { flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #0B2418); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; padding: 6px 0; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #61685C); } .ds-send { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary, #0B2418); color: var(--primary-ink, #FAF7EF); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 160ms; } .ds-send:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0B2418); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Funnel OS looks like a tidy workbench on warm paper. Ivory pages carry forest green ink, two sages mark the small things, and the one dark object on the bench is the night band where a funnel gets built. The chrome stays quiet so the funnel, the copy and the coach's answers own the screen.

A fixed sidebar holds the builder and the coach, a 60px top bar names the page, and the work sits in a 740px reading column or a 1080px builder pane, which keeps the density calm and even. Depth comes from paper steps and 1px hairlines, so very little floats. State changes take 160ms on one ease curve, and the longer sequences stay inside the build band.

Dark mode keeps the same structure in deep forest with ivory ink and a pale sage accent. It follows the system setting until the person picks a theme with the moon button.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, Plus Jakarta Sans, with tight tracking on anything 22px and up.
Four paper steps for depth: Ivory Paper, Side Paper, Raised Paper and Sage Wash.
Nearly square chrome, softer builder cards, round conversation, pills for chips and secondary actions.
Forest Ink carries all the weight; the sages mark small icons, list markers and states.
Two night bands that stay deep forest in both themes.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Forest Ink is the only heavy color in the light theme. Primary buttons, the active tab, the running step and error text all use it, so weight always means the same thing.

rules.name: The Calm Error Rule
rules.body: Errors and warnings are ink on Side Paper inside a 1px control hairline, with a next step and a link to the fix. Red and amber stay out of the chrome. Band Fault appears only inside the build core.

rules.name: The Night Band Rule
rules.body: The build stage and the build core stay deep forest in light and dark mode. Glass, glow and Band Signal live there and nowhere else.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans sets the whole interface. To change it, edit the font variable at the top of css/app.css and the Google Fonts link in index.html.

rules.name: The Tight Large Type Rule
rules.body: Type at 22px and up tracks between -0.03em and -0.04em with line height between 1.04 and 1.2. Body text keeps normal tracking.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Cards, menus and dialogs separate with a 1px hairline and a paper step. A new shadow needs a job the four above do not cover.

rules.name: The Corner Family Rule
rules.body: Take the corner from the object's family: chrome, builder card or conversation. Two families inside one component reads as a mistake.

dos: **Do** keep one primary action per view in Forest Ink with 2px corners.
**Do** give every error a next step and a link to the place to fix it, inside a notice.
**Do** use Deep Sage and Field Sage for icons, list markers, citations, done states and the selection highlight.
**Do** take every color from the theme variables at the top of css/app.css so light and dark stay in step.
**Do** keep state changes at 160ms on the shared ease curve (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) and honor reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows to cards, menus or dialogs.
**Don't** draw a thick colored stripe on one side of a notice or card.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a red and amber alert palette to the chrome.
**Don't** round chrome controls past 4px or give pills square corners.
**Don't** put small uppercase tracked labels above headings.
**Don't** add glass blur, glow or color gradient fills to paper surfaces.
